purpose: Evidence ledger for the walkable connection from the existing linked-keep courtyard to the Honmaru main plaza without presenting unsupported monumental stairs or retaining walls as historical structure.
coordinate_policy: PLATEAU and GSI aerial horizontal registration is unchanged. Gate centres, path widths, lower approach grade, low sidewalls and exact stair tread/riser dimensions are C estimates unless explicitly stated otherwise. Only the official nine-step count near 二ノ門 is represented as a counted stair run.

sources.title: 松山城筋鉄門
facts: 筋鉄門は天守と小天守の間に建つ一重櫓門
三ノ門と共に天守南側の枡形を形成

sources.title: 松山城筋鉄門東塀
facts: 三ノ門南櫓と筋鉄門を結ぶ渡塀
本壇入口から本丸広場大手方向に備える

sources.title: 松山城三の門
facts: 二ノ門を入った左手の天守穴蔵石垣沿いに北面して建つ
三ノ門を過ぎ天守石垣下を右折すると筋鉄門（内庭入口）に達する

sources.title: 松山城二の門
facts: 一ノ門と二ノ門の間は枡形を構成
一ノ門内で左折し九段の石段を上ると二ノ門に至る

sources.title: 松山城一の門
facts: 本壇入口に西面して建つ
一ノ門と二ノ門の間は枡形を構成

sources.title: 天守と本壇
facts: 本壇は本丸よりさらに約8m高い
出入口は一ノ門の1か所
天守までは複数の門を通る

implementation.courtyard_gate_cut: south-west end of the current inner-courtyard southern PLATEAU wall; best-fit to documented 筋鉄門 / 筋鉄門東塀 relationship
implementation.documented_step_geometry_accuracy: count from official description; tread/riser geometry C
implementation.lower_approach: one continuous C-grade approach, offset west of the frontal axis, rising from the Honmaru aerial-photo datum to an inferred west-facing 一ノ門 landing
implementation.lower_approach_accuracy: C plan, slope and width; no claim that the rendered grade reproduces the historical paving profile
implementation.sidewalls: six short low bands, each approximately 0.55 m thick, 0.55 m below and 1.15 m above the inferred grade; C visual/collision guidance only, not reconstructed rampart faces
implementation.sidewall_policy: sidewalls follow the grade itself and must not be filled down to the Honmaru datum, preventing a large triangular invented wall from appearing in the plaza view
implementation.one_mon_relationship: approach enters from the west, then turns north/left toward the official nine-step run; relationship follows city descriptions, coordinates are C

rejected_representations.description: 39 individually rendered lower steps from the Honmaru plaza to the upper landing
rejected_representations.reason: They were only a continuity interpolation and visually implied an unsupported exposed monumental staircase in front of the keep.

rejected_representations.description: two retaining wedges filled from the sloping approach all the way down to the plaza datum
rejected_representations.reason: They appeared as monumental triangular wall slabs not supported by PLATEAU or official dimensional evidence.
